scope: Read-only shipped mi_thermald, saved runtime policy/AVC and source policy/API inspection; no phone/source/build/process changes.
method: LLVM static disassembly/dynamic imports plus GNU .gnu_debugdata decompressed and parsed only in memory for function names. Not REA decompilation. No engine installation or retry.

debugdata_section.handling: LZMA decompressed to memory; ELF symbol table parsed without saving vendor code/ELF

runtime.duplicate_limit: Both property lines refer to audit652, one denial duplicated by two log producers.
runtime.limits: No syscall stack/path in capability AVC. Static call sites corroborate operation class; no Enforcing result or exact first triggering path proved.

chown_calls.creation: If access check fails, open(O_WRONLY|O_CREAT,0600) precedes chmod/chown.

other_chmod_calls.target: Assembled thermal config path in global buffer VA0xb9240
Selected map file pointer; data thermal-map.conf candidate literal exists
Assembled thermal backup config path in global buffer VA0xb9644
Assembled thermal config path in stack buffer

chmod_bounds.guard: For config paths, stat success and a test that required0644 mode bits are missing precede chmod. If required bits already present, chmod is skipped.
chmod_bounds.failure: Shown direct chmod/chown negative return branches conditionally log and continue rather than abort.
limits: No direct sysfs chmod/chown call was found among these fixed direct PLT call sites.
Changing ownership/mode is not path-confined by a capability grant.
Do not describe all config calls as data-only: /odm/etc/%s is also an assembled branch.

existing_mac_contract.thermal_files: thermal_data_file:file already allows create/getattr/open/read/rename/setattr/unlink/write. Common file_contexts:50 labels /data/vendor/thermal(/.*)? thermal_data_file.
existing_mac_contract.sysfs: Existing sysfs/vendor battery/display/graphics policy provides read/write but no newly proposed setattr. Vendor/ODm file_type reads/execute do not gain setattr.
existing_mac_contract.other_existing_setattr: Saved loaded policy also has inherited vendor_gles_data_file create/manage/setattr. Proposed capabilities are constrained by all existing MAC permissions, not just thermal_data_file.
existing_mac_contract.service: Existing init.mi_thermald.rc runs user root/group system with explicit mi_thermald seclabel. No service capability-list or UID change is proposed.

bcl_status.placement: At the end of main setup path; next instructions call pause at0x9c678 and branch back to pause. Setter return value is ignored.
bcl_status.own_reader: No direct literal property_get of this exact key found. Only one literal copy and corresponding immediate reference to setter was found in focused scan; dynamically constructed reads are not excluded.
bcl_status.algorithm_limit: Boot-completed status write is not evidence of a BCL power-target or brightness algorithm modification.

consumer_search.limits: Scoped text search excludes APK/JAR/constructed keys and unrelated full binary collection; no general claim that all consumers are absent.

bcl_status.needed_key_search: Exact key not found in directly named vendor/odm lib64 dependencies that existed. This is not transitive dynamic-load coverage.

saved_file_and_property_service_contract.subject: ksu
saved_file_and_property_service_contract.rights: Existing dynamic broad rights; unchanged and not considered evidence of ordinary API access

reuse_existing_property_type.reader_limit: No other ordinary explicit readers found through these loaded type/attribute targets. vendor_public_prop is an ownership category, not an automatic read grant to every domain.
reuse_existing_property_type.ownership: Key is vendor.-namespaced. Exact mapping to existing vendor-owned public thermal type avoids an unproven new type and avoids generic vendor_default_prop set. Keep existing neverallows and prefix validators enabled.

no_changes: No new file setattr or file access
No DAC override/read_search or other capabilities
No thermal algorithms/values or CPU/brightness tuning
proposed_minimal_delta.neverallow_status: Explicit chown/fowner neverallow statements were not found in inspected platform/domain and sm8550 source policy sets; broader subject/wildcard rules still require the full normal compiler neverallow gate. This analysis is not a compilation result.
proposed_minimal_delta.capability_boundary: Capabilities cannot be constrained per pathname. Restriction comes from mi_thermald domain and existing file MAC/RO-filesystem protections. This includes all current allowed targets, not only the listed calls.
